limitations: One seeded modest run on fixed subsets; paired p-values are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons. No general improvement or retention equivalence claim.

primary_metrics.mmlu: first case-preserved word-boundary uppercase A-D fallback (case-insensitive whole single letter accepted)

selection.rule: minimum validation loss among steps 32/64 only; exact tie selects step 32; no test or generation override

training.wall_time_scope: Whole Trainer.train interval including scheduled validation and checkpoint saves; not pure optimizer compute
training.allocator_scope: Peak PyTorch selected-GPU allocation over the whole Trainer.train interval, including loaded weights, scheduled validation and checkpoint saves; not total VRAM or other processes

paired_primary_fallback.interpretation: Exploratory, unadjusted exact two-sided McNemar; b=broken=base right/adapter wrong, c=fixed=base wrong/adapter right. No continuity correction; zero discordant pairs gives p=1.

paired_secondary_strict.interpretation: Exploratory, unadjusted exact two-sided McNemar; b=broken=base right/adapter wrong, c=fixed=base wrong/adapter right. No continuity correction; zero discordant pairs gives p=1.

base.invalid_definition: not an exact case-insensitive single A-D letter
